'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Guayana Esequiba crisis]], [[Brazil–Venezuela relations]]
**The [[Brazilian Army]] mobilizes towards the border of [[Venezuela]] and [[Guyana]], anticipating a possible [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|Venezuelan military]] [[invasion]] of [[Guayana Esequiba]]. [https://www.escenariomundial.com/2023/11/29/el-ejercito-de-brasil-se-dispone-en-alerta-maxima-por-una-posible-invasion-de-venezuela-a-guyana/ (Escenario Mundial)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***[[2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire]]
****[[Hamas]] releases four [[Thai people|Thai]] [[migrant worker]]s and 12 [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[hostage]]s while [[Israel]] releases 30 [[Palestinian prisoners]]. In a separate gesture to [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]], two  dual citizens of Israel and [[Russia]] are also freed by Hamas. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/in-6th-release-12-israelis-and-4-thais-freed-from-gaza-following-54-days-of-captivity/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
**[[October-November 2023 Jenin incursion]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces]], [[Shin Bet]], and [[Israel Border Police]] announce in a joint statement that they killed Muhammad Zubeidi, the commander of the Jenin branch of the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-775697 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***Two children, aged 14 and 8, are shot dead by IDF troops in Jenin during the raid. The shootings are caught by security cameras. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-67572278/ (BBC)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[Myanmar National Democratic Alliance Army]] captures the town of [[Konkyan]] in [[Shan State]], [[Myanmar]], after the [[Tatmadaw|military]]'s Light Infantry Battalion 125 surrendered to it. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/another-entire-junta-battalion-raises-the-white-flag-in-myanmars-northern-shan-state.html (''The Irrawaddy'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The 15th-century painting ''{{ill| Madonna delle Grazie (Botticelli)|it|lt=Madonna delle Grazie}}'' by [[Sandro Botticelli]], with an estimated value of €100 million, which was believed to be missing, is recovered from a residence near [[Naples]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2023/nov/29/madonna-and-child-painting-botticelli-recovered-50-years-naples-italy (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Austria]]'s largest privately owned real estate company [[Signa Holding]] files for [[insolvency]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/austrias-signa-launch-self-administrated-insolvency-proceedings-2023-11-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*{{ill|2023 Yakushima V-22 Osprey crash|ja|屋久島沖米軍オスプレイ墜落事故}}
**A [[United States Air Force]] [[Bell Boeing V-22 Osprey|V-22 Osprey]] crashes off the coast of [[Japan]]'s [[Kagoshima Prefecture]] with six crew members onboard. A [[search and rescue]] operation has been launched, according to the [[Japan Coast Guard]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/11/29/asia/us-osprey-aircraft-crashes-japan-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Finland–Poland relations]], [[Finland–Russia relations]]
**[[National Security Bureau (Poland)|National Security Bureau]] chief [[Jacek Siewiera]] announces that [[Poland]] will send "a team of [[military advisor|military advisors]]" to the [[Finland–Russia border]] in response to an official request for allied support. Finland says it was unaware of the Polish offer. [[Russia]] warns against the move, viewing the concentration of troops on the border as a threat. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-reported-polish-plan-send-troops-finnish-border-says-it-will-stoke-2023-11-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Recognition of same-sex unions in Nepal]]
**A village authority in [[Gandaki Province]], [[Nepal]], registers the nation's first [[same-sex marriage]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nepal-registers-first-same-sex-marriage-historic-say-activists-2023-11-29/ (Reuters)]
*[[Germany|German]] authorities launch major [[Police raid|raids]] and arrests against the right-wing Wehrsportgruppe {{ill|Knockout 51|de}} and the [[Reichsbürger movement|Reichsbürger group]] "Königreich Deutschland". [https://taz.de/Rechtsextreme-Kampfsportler-Knockout51/!5977071/ (Taz)] [https://www.zeit.de/gesellschaft/zeitgeschehen/2023-11/reichsbuerger-durchsuchung-illegale-geschaefte-krankenkasse (Zeit)]
*[[Minister of Justice (France)|French Minister of Justice]] [[Éric Dupond-Moretti]] is acquitted of a charge of conflict of interest by the [[Cour de Justice de la République]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20231129-french-justice-minister-awaits-court-ruling-in-conflict-of-interest-case (France 24)] 

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Right Livelihood Award]]
**[[Eunice Brookman-Amissah]], [[Mother Nature Cambodia]], [[Phyllis Omido]] and [[SOS Méditerranée]] are honored with the Right Livelihood Award in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/europa/rightlivelihoodaward-preisverleihung-100.html (Tagesschau)]
*[[Solar Cycle 25]]
**[[NASA]] says that a [[coronal mass ejection]] directed at [[Earth]] will result in a [[geomagnetic storm]] causing disruption to [[radio]] and [[Global Positioning System|GPS]] communications on November 30, particularly in the [[Southern Hemisphere]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/etimes/trending/caution-solar-storm-to-hit-earth-on-november-30-will-disrupt-mobile-communication/articleshow/105568089.cms?from=mdr (''The Times of India'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Winter Olympic Games]]
**The [[International Olympic Committee]] announces that a [[French Alps]]/[[Nice]] bid is the preferred candidate to host the [[2030 Winter Olympics]] and that [[Salt Lake City]], [[Utah]], [[United States]], is the preferred candidate to host the 2034 Winter Olympics.
